customizations.originalPurpose: Enforces 32-char signing secret in docker-compose mode, bypasses SSL for local PostGIS container networking, and sets default noetlevents=true to prevent AWS SQS crashes without AWS credentials.
customizations.evidence: Config.envInit() guards offline startup; removal triggers unhandled rejection attempting AWS Secrets Manager calls.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Requires native upstream CLI/env flags for standalone non-AWS operation and local PostgreSQL TLS disablement.

customizations.originalPurpose: Guards submit() message queuing with this.config.noetlevents check to avoid AWS STS / SQS calls.
customizations.evidence: Bypasses queueUrl resolution in docker-compose offline environments.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Requires upstream to support noetlevents natively in ETLEvents.submit().

customizations.originalPurpose: Adds support for direct AUTHENTIK_API_TOKEN environment variable without requiring AWS Secrets Manager SecretId ARN.
customizations.evidence: Allows AuthentikProvider.init() to authenticate directly against self-hosted Authentik using static tokens.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Requires upstream CloudTAK to natively support direct bearer tokens for Authentik integration.

customizations.originalPurpose: Implements resolveInternalUrl() for dual-homed Docker backchannel routing (identity-server:9000 vs localhost:9000), getCanonicalHostHeaders(), and validateIdToken() per RFC 7519.
customizations.evidence: Enables CloudTAK inside Docker bridge network to communicate with Authentik while browsers access public ports; validates JWT signature, audience, issuer, exp, and nonce.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Requires upstream to decouple backchannel endpoint host from browser authorization URL without flat DNS requirement.

customizations.originalPurpose: Injects dual-homed OIDC discovery, nonce verification, Authentik tactical group mapping, advisory-locked TAK cert issuance, and public IdP logout redirects.
customizations.evidence: Handles /api/login/oidc, /api/login/oidc/callback, and /api/login/logout in self-hosted multi-group tactical deployments.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Requires upstream to support environment-driven OIDC bootstrapping, nonce validation, and non-AWS certificate locking.

customizations.originalPurpose: Enables AuthentikProvider direct token access in agency scoping, connection management, and LDAP outpost routes.
customizations.evidence: Permits agency listing and channel assignment using AUTHENTIK_API_TOKEN.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Requires upstream route handlers to recognize direct API tokens.

customizations.originalPurpose: Self-hosted Compose definition orchestrating PostGIS 17, Garage S3 (v2.4.1), Authentik (2024.12.3), MediaMTX, CloudTAK API, tiles, events, and retention.
customizations.evidence: Primary operational deployment specification for TISCK appliance.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Not replaceable - owned by TISCK deployment layer.

customizations.originalPurpose: Vendor branch management, 3-way merge execution, Authentik group bootstrapping, Garage S3 bucket provisioning, and identity secret generation.
customizations.evidence: Powers zero-touch provisioning and upstream synchronization.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Not replaceable - owned by TISCK operations layer.

customizations.originalPurpose: Non-destructive regression verification for OIDC URLs, ID tokens, tactical groups, signing secret enforcement, browser login, and persistent volume recovery.
customizations.evidence: Validates runtime invariants without mutating production database or storage.
customizations.replacementCriteria: Not replaceable - owned by TISCK verification layer.
